SELECT `t`.`Id`, `t`.`DataHora`, `c`.`Nome` AS `Cliente`, `s`.`Nome` AS `Servico`
FROM (
    SELECT `m`.`Id`, `m`.`ClienteId`, `m`.`DataHora`, `m`.`ServicoId`
    FROM `Marcacoes` AS `m`
    WHERE (`m`.`DataHora` > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) AND (`m`.`Estado` <> 'Cancelada')
    ORDER BY `m`.`DataHora`
    LIMIT @__p_0
) AS `t`
INNER JOIN `Clientes` AS `c` ON `t`.`ClienteId` = `c`.`Id`
